content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Reviewers
content.note: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development period up to and including 2020).

reviewers.Details: Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Companies listed: Novartis (Cardiology).
Membership or affiliation in political, advocacy or patients organisations working in the field of cardiology. Example: American Heart Association is a charity advocating for health.

Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Companies listed: Bayer (Anticoagulants/heart failure), Boehringer-Ingelheim (Diabetes and cardiovascular diseases/heart failure), AstraZeneca (Heart Failure), Novartis (Heart failure).
